title: SOH Estimator
text: State of health estimator, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Algorithm data type} sets Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit:; {Vector of state-of-charge values, SOC (-)} sets the sOC breakpoints, {Vector of temperatures, T} sets the temperature breakpoints, {Terminal resistance when battery cell is new, R0new(SOC,T), (ohm)} and {Terminal resistance at end of life, R0eol(SOC,T), (ohm)}. Values come from the instance.
